and the action of the respondent authorities of applying seals to the shops of the petitioners and restraining the petitioners from NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED:
08/08/2023 undefined doing business sale of mutton/meat/chicken the respective shops, that too the said action of the authorities of applying seals and restraining the petitioners from doing their retail business of sale of chicken/ meat/mutton may kindly be quashed and set aside as the same is illegal, illogical, arbitrary, discriminatory, violative of Article 14, 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India and is violative of principles of natural justice and therefore the said action of respondent authorities of applying seals and restraining the petitioners from doing business of sale of Chicken/meat/mutton may kindly be quashed and set aside, and the communication / notices dated 08/02/2023 (ANNEXURE-D) may kindly be quashed and set aside

as the same are illegal, illogical,
arbitrary, discriminatory, violative of Article 14, 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India and is violative of principles of natural justice; and therefore the action of the respondent authorities of applying seals and restraining the petitioners from doing business of sale of chicken/meant/mutton through their shops, and the same is in breach of principles of natural Justice and therefore also the same may kindly be quashed and set aside and the respondents may kindly be directed to open the seals applied on the shops of the petitioners and the petitioners may kindly be allowed to do their business through their respective shops, situated in near Khatkivaad, Near Masjid in Dabhoi Town.

(C) By way of interim order be pleased to direct the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/08/2023 undefined respondent authorities to make-open the seals applied to the respective shops of the petitioners as per the details mentioned in the tabular form statement annexed at ANNEXURE-A, and respondents may kindly be directed to allow the petitioners to do their business of sale of meat/ chicken/mutton through their shops situated in near Khatkivaad,
Near Masjid in Dabhoi Town, pending admission and final hearing of the present petition.
(D) By way of interim order be pleased to direct the respondent authorities to do their lawful business of selling meat/chicken/mutton through their respective shops, as per tabular form statement annexed to the present petition as ANNEXURE-A, pending admission and final hearing of the present petition.
(E) Be pleased to pass such orders as thought fit in the interest of justice."
2. Heard Mr. N. K. Majmudar, the learned advocate appearing for the writ-applicants, Ms. Bhavna D. Acharya, the learned advocate appearing for the respondent No.4 and Ms. Dharitri Pancholi, the learned advocate appearing for the respondent No.6.
3.

The writ-applicants herein are a group of persons NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/08/2023 undefined carrying out business of selling live poultry and mutton slaughtered in government dedicated slaughter house since past two decades situated near Khatkivaad, Near Masjid in Dabhoi Town.

It is the case of the writ-applicants herein that the writ-applicants herein are in receipt of valid license issued by the respondent Nos. 2 to 4 vide Moeenul Haq Ibrahimbhai Kureshi vs The Commissioner, Food Safety Food And ... on 8 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13930948/
2 various certificates to carry on the business of poultry selling and selling slaughtered mutton.

sentences.text:
5. Learned advocates appearing for the respective parties have jointly submitted that the reliefs, as prayed for by the writ-applicants herein, would be governed by the order dated 11.04.2023 passed by the Division Bench in Civil Application (For Direction) No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.
133 of 2021 and connected Civil Applications.

5.1 At this stage, it is apposite to refer to the operative part of the said order passed by the Division Bench in Civil NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/08/2023 undefined Application (For Direction) No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No. 133 of 2021 and connected Civil Applications dated 11.04.2023, wherein Para-6 reads thus:
"6. All the meat shops and slaughter houses which are closed by the authorities for the reason that they have failed to comply with the licencing and regulatory norms,
food and safety standards, pollution control requirements and for any such other legal considerations including non-observance of hygiene imperatives, could hardly be permitted to be reopened on spacious grounds, unless they become fully compliant of such norms and regulations.
Intervention is not called for by the court when it comes to abiding by the food safety etc. norms.
It would be an overriding principle that the public concerns of hygiene and food safety will have to prevail.
6.1 The details and figures furnished by the State Authorities in their affidavit-in-replies, which have been noted in above, do suggest that the authorities have acted pragmatic.
All slaughter houses and meat shops are not ordered to be closed.
Those who are norms compliant, are permitted to run their business.

Even the shops and premises owners who are given the show cause notice or whose shops are ordered to be closed, could meet with the requirements of law and NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/08/2023 undefined after fulfilling the norms, may approach the competent authority or competent committee seeking to reopen their business premises or shops.
The State Slaughter Committee and District Level Committees are functional.

6.2 For all the forgoing reasons, except granting prayer in Civil Application No.11 of 2023, allowing the applicants thereof to join as parties in the main Writ Petition (PIL), no relief in rest of the Civil Applications could be granted.

6.3 It is however, observed that it will be open for any meat shop owner, meat vendor or slaughter house owner to approach the competent authority or competent committee by showing that it has ensured compliance of all the laws and regulations Moeenul Haq Ibrahimbhai Kureshi vs The Commissioner, Food Safety Food And ... on 8 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13930948/
3

In all such cases, it is provided, the competent authority or the State or District Level Committee as the case may be, shall permit the shop or slaughter house to be reopened, permitting the owner or vendor to run the business by continuing to comply with the business norms.

6.4 It is also observed that if any such application is made by any shop owner or vendor, it shall be dealt with expeditiously without booking delay."
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/08/2023 undefined 6.

Considering the facts being undisputed, the order passed in the Civil Application (For Direction)
No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No. 133 of 2021 and connected Civil Applications dated 11.04.2023, shall govern the present writ-application.

The parties are directed to comply with the direction issued by the Division Bench in Para-6 of the order dated 11.04.2023 passed in Civil Application (For Direction) No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No.133 of 2021 and connected Civil Applications.

6. Considering the facts of the present case the respondent No.4 to issue notice to the writ-applicants if there are any infirmities that have been noticed by the authority and the writ-applicants be permitted to cure the said infirmities, if any, in line with the aforesaid order passed by the Hon'ble Division Bench in Writ Petition (PIL) No. 133 of 2021 and connected Civil Applications 7.
With the aforesaid direction, the present writ-application is disposed of.
The aforesaid order is passed with the consent of learned advocates appearing for the respective parties.
8. This Court has otherwise not opined on the merits of the matter.
Direct service is permitted.
